Commitments of Traders — Dashboard Barchart data

Data retrieved from barchart.com: Commitments of Traders positions (the CFTC's Legacy futures-only report, released Fridays 15:30 US Eastern) and weekly prices of the nearest futures contract. Crude oil is the NYMEX WTI contract (CL). Barchart publishes long/short breakdowns for roughly the latest year only, so the Long Ratio charts start there and gain a week with every update; net positions, the Composite Index and Stochastics run back to 2000. Non-Commercial = large speculators, Commercial = hedgers, Non-Reportable = small traders. Net position = long − short. Percentile ranks and Stochastic %K are computed as described on each chart.
